metadata.title: Curve theory in $S^2\times S^2$ with applications to ruled surfaces in $S^3$
metadata.abstract: The Riemannian product $S^2\times S^2$ of two unit spheres admits several important geometric interpretations. It can be identified both with the complex quadric $Q^2$ and with the space $\mathcal{L}(S^3)$ of oriented geodesics in the unit $3$-sphere $S^3$. In this paper, we first develop a unified framework for the geometry of curves in $S^2\times S^2$. We introduce projection-regular curves in $S^2\times S^2$ and their curvature data, and prove a congruence theorem for these curves. As an application of this framework, regarding $S^2\times S^2$ as the complex quadric $Q^2$, we classify Kähler magnetic geodesics associated with the product Kähler--Einstein structure. For closed generic projection-regular curves, we establish a sharp Fenchel-type inequality. We then identify $S^2\times S^2$ with the space $\mathcal{L}(S^3)$ of oriented geodesics in the unit $3$-sphere $S^3$ and apply our curve theory to ruled surfaces in $S^3$. In particular, we prove that every nonsingular closed generic projection-regular ruled surface attaining equality in the Fenchel-type inequality is an embedded torus.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: S²×S²曲线的统一曲率理论与球面直纹曲面
analysis.workSummary: 在单位球面乘积S²×S²中引入projection-regular曲线及曲率数据，证明全等定理。经复二次曲面解释分类乘积Kähler–Einstein结构的Kähler磁测地线；对闭generic projection-regular曲线建立尖锐Fenchel型不等式，再经S³定向测地线空间解释研究直纹曲面。
techniques: 投影正则曲线的曲率数据
analysis.breakthrough: 把曲线、复几何及球面直纹曲面放入统一模型；等号下无奇点闭generic projection-regular直纹曲面为嵌入环面。
analysis.limitations: Fenchel及环面结论需保留闭、generic、投影正则及无奇点条件，不能推广到所有S³直纹曲面。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
